title: One Piece Anime's First 325 Episodes Stream on Crunchyroll in India
content: Crunchyroll began streaming the anime's Elbaph arc in India on April 5. The Elbaph arc debuted in Japan on April 5. Netflix is streaming the arc in India as well. Crunchyroll will stream the English dub of the arc (from episode 1156) in India beginning on October 20.
author: ANN

title: Japanese Film Festival India Reveals New Delhi Schedule, Screens Suzume, 'Colorful Stage!,' More
content: The screenings in "Audi 1" will be ticketed, while the screenings in "Audi 5" will be free entry. The following anime films will screen in Audi 1: • Suzume - October 3 at 11:00 a.m. IST • My Hero Academia: You're Next - October 3 at 1:45 p.m. IST • COLORFUL STAGE!

title: 'Hell Mode' Third Season in Production
content: • The 13th and final episode of Hell Mode: Yarikomizuki no Gamer wa Hai Settei no Isekai de Musou suru 2nd Season ( Hell Mode: The Hardcore Gamer Dominates in Another World with Garbage Balancing Season 2 ) ended with an announcement on Friday that a third season is in production.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Kore Kaite Shine' Gets Second Season
content: The 12th and final episode of Kore Kaite Shine ( Draw This, Then Die! ) ended with an announcement on Saturday that a second season is in production. The official website also revealed an announcement visual (pictured right).
author: MyAnimeList

title: Please Excuse My Younger Brothers TV Anime Reveals More Cast, New Ending Theme
content: The staff for the television anime adaptation of Akira Ozaki 's Please Excuse My Younger Brothers ( Uchi no Otōto-domo ga Sumimasen ) manga revealed the third promotional video and a second key visual on Friday for the show's second cours (quarter of a year). The second cours will start on October 2.
author: ANN

title: 'Draw This, Then Die!' Anime Gets 2nd Season
content: The official website for the television anime of Minoru Toyoda 's Draw This, Then Die! ( Kore Kaite Shine ) manga announced on Saturday that the anime will get a second season. The 12th and final episode of the first season aired on Friday.
author: ANN

title: Tatsuki Fujimoto 17-26 Anime, My Melody & Kuromi Stop-Motion Animated Series Nominated for International Emmy
content: Winners will be announced at New York City on November 23. The Tatsuki Fujimoto 17-26 had its world premiere in October 2025 during the Global Stage Hollywood Film Festival 2025 at the TCL Chinese 6 Theatre in Hollywood.
author: ANN
